templates.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "T1"."account_id") FROM "public"."account" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "public"."district" AS "T2" ON "T1"."district_id" = "T2"."district_id" WHERE "T2"."A3" = 'east Bohemia' AND "T1"."frequency" = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
